news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 3 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 3 independent directors. 5 non-independent directors. Additional Independent Director Raghupathy Bhat was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Lack of board continuity.

news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.51 (vs ₹0.63 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.51 (down from ₹0.63 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹300.6m (down 27% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹7.31m (down 19% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 2.4% (up from 2.2% in 1H 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses.
